name: Margireta Sirios
original_name: マルギレッタ・シリオス
source:
Princess of Enonnoze
Princess gained trust from nation's people with her heart gentle character, despite her high status she is offering support to unfortunate and poor people. In contrary greedy nobles tend to dislike that form of charity and lust for gold. She wishes to govern kingdom in ideal way to put it back in right tracks, but suffers greatly from the fact that she must use dirty methods in order to do so.
